latestBrief.title: Daily Briefing | 7 November 2026: US October non-farm payrolls rose by 165,000, far exceeding expectations; the probability of a December interest rate hike has risen to 78 per cent; the AI sell-off has spread to Asia, triggering a circuit breaker on the South Korean stock market; China’s ChiNext Index fell by nearly 4 per cent; the China Securities Regulatory Commission plans to relax restrictions on share buybacks aimed at stabilising the market; and the expected valuation for Anthropic’s IPO has been revised downwards.
